buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Text-Based ATC Clauses 1. Acceptance of ATC. Submission of bid by the bidder shall be deemed to constitute unconditional acce ptance of all Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC), technical specifications and other conditions of the bid. 2. Warranty Certificate. The successful bidder shall submit a valid Warranty Certificate along with the s upplied item/equipment. The warranty shall cover defects in material, workmanship and performance as a pplicable under the contract. 3. Failure/Operational Error during Warranty. Any defect/failure occurring during the warranty period under normal authorized use shall be attended to by the vendor without additional cost, wherever covered under the warranty. Repair/replacement shall be carried out within the stipulated period. 4. Payment after Completion. Payment shall be released only after complete supply/work, installation/c ommissioning wherever applicable, satisfactory inspection, testing/trial and final acceptance by the consig nee/Competent Authority. No payment shall be due merely on partial supply or delivery. 5. Inspection & Acceptance. The department/consignee shall have the right to inspect, examine and te st the supplied items at any stage. The material shall be accepted only after satisfactory verification of qu ality, quantity, specifications and performance.

6. Right of Rejection. If the supplied material/equipment is found defective, damaged, substandard, inco mplete, not as per specifications or fails to meet the required performance parameters, the department sh all have the right to reject the same. The decision of the Competent Authority/Consignee based on inspecti on, testing and prescribed specifications shall be final and binding, subject to applicable Government rules and contractual dispute-resolution provisions. 7. Replacement of Rejected Material. Any rejected material shall be removed and replaced/rectified b y the vendor at his own cost and risk, without any additional financial liability to the department. 8. No Extra Claim. The vendor shall not be entitled to claim any additional payment, compensation, escalation, transportation charges, labour charges or other incidental expenses arising due to rejection, re- testing, replacement or rectification of defective/non-conforming material. 9. Fall Clause. If the vendor supplies the same or similar item to any Government Department/Organisati on/Agency at a price lower than the accepted contract rate during the applicable period, the vendor shall i nform the department and extend the benefit of such lower rate to the department. The vendor shall main tain the accepted rate for a period of one year from the date of acceptance order, as applicable, and shall not offer the same item to another Government organisation at a lower rate without extending the corresp onding benefit to this department. 10. Risk of Damage/Loss. The material/equipment shall remain at the sole risk and responsibility of the vendor until satisfactory delivery, inspection, testing and final acceptance by the department. Any loss, da mage, breakage or deterioration prior to acceptance shall be borne by the vendor. 11. Quality Assurance. All supplied items shall be new, unused, genuine and of good quality and shall st rictly conform to the technical specifications, applicable standards and requirements mentioned in the bid. Used, refurbished or substandard material shall not be accepted unless specifically permitted. 12. Made in India/Local Content. Wherever applicable, the bidder shall comply with the prevailing Make in India/local-content requirements and shall submit the requisite declaration/certificate as prescribe d. 13. Trial/Demonstration. Where trial, demonstration or performance testing is required, the vendor shall provide all necessary manpower, equipment, accessories, consumables and technical support at his own c ost for successful conduct of the trial. 14. Date & Time of Trial. The trial/testing shall be conducted on the date, time and location communica ted by the department. The vendor shall ensure the availability of competent technical representatives an d required equipment. 15. No Automatic Extension of Trial Date. Failure of the bidder/vendor to attend the trial on the sched uled date due to reasons attributable to the vendor shall not automatically entitle the vendor to an additio nal trial date or extension of delivery/completion period. Any rescheduling shall be solely at the discretion of the Competent Authority. 16. Weather/Operational Conditions. The bidder/vendor shall be prepared to conduct trials under prev ailing operational conditions, including day/night and seasonal conditions such as summer, winter and rain y season, wherever technically feasible and safe. Normal weather or seasonal variations shall not by them selves constitute a ground for claiming additional time or cost. 17. Trial Failure. If the item/equipment fails during trial/testing to meet the prescribed technical specifica tions or performance parameters, the vendor shall rectify/replace the item at his own cost and risk, as dire cted by the Competent Authority. Repeated failure may result in rejection and other action as per applicab le contract conditions/rules. 18. No Claim for Trial Expenses. All expenses relating to transportation, manpower, installation, demon stration, testing, trial, tools, accessories and other incidental requirements necessary for successful compl etion of the trial shall be borne by the vendor unless specifically provided otherwise in the bid. 19. Non-Blacklisting Declaration. The bidder shall submit a valid declaration/undertaking that the firm is not blacklisted/debarred by any competent Government authority, wherever required under the bid con ditions. Any false declaration or concealment of material facts shall make the bidder liable for action as per applicable rules. 20. False Declaration/False Documents. Submission of any false, forged, fabricated or misleading doc ument/information shall result in appropriate action as per applicable Government procurement rules, incl uding rejection of bid/termination of contract and other action as legally permissible.

21. Compliance with Technical Specifications. No deviation from the approved technical specification s shall be permitted without prior written approval of the Competent Authority. Any unauthorized deviation may lead to rejection of the supplied item. 22. Scope of Work/Supply. The vendor shall be responsible for completing the entire scope of supply/w ork within the stipulated delivery/completion period. Partial completion shall not be treated as satisfactory completion unless specifically accepted by the department. 23. No Waiver by Acceptance of Partial Supply. Acceptance of any partial quantity or temporary rece ipt of material shall not constitute final acceptance and shall not relieve the vendor of his contractual oblig ations. 24. Vendor's Responsibility. The vendor shall remain responsible for the quality, conformity, performan ce and completeness of the supplied items/work until final acceptance by the department. 25. Dispute Resolution. Any dispute arising out of the contract shall be dealt with in accordance with th e dispute-resolution mechanism prescribed in the bid/contract and the applicable Government procuremen t rules. No clause of this ATC shall be interpreted as excluding any mandatory statutory or contractual rem edy. 26. Final Acceptance. Final acceptance shall be issued only after satisfactory completion of supply/work, inspection, testing/trial, rectification of deficiencies, submission of required certificates/documents and co mpliance with all contractual requirements. 27. General Condition. All other terms and conditions of the GeM/e-Bid document, technical specificatio ns, applicable Government procurement rules and contractual provisions shall remain applicable. In case o f any conflict, the provisions of the applicable bid/contract and Government rules shall prevail. 28. No Made in China Material. No made in China material will be accepted. A certificate in this regard is to be submitted by the bidder. 29. Defect Rectification within 48 Hours. Dealer should have a self-declaration certificate stating that if any defect is raised in the project, the same should be rectified within 48 hours. 30. Details of Contact Person for Repairs. The bidder has to provide the name, mobile number, Aadha ar Card, e-mail address details, along with the photograph of the person to be contacted during a fault for repairing of goods. 31. Rejection for Missing/Incorrect Documents. The bidder will be directly rejected in absence of/lack ing/incorrectness in any document. No clarification, no entertainment will be accepted thereafter. . 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address 11 Engr Regt Bhopal - - - . 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque.

d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 6. Sample Clause For clothing and allied items, if pre-dispatch Inspection clause has been selected in the Bid, the Inspection Agency shall forward sample from the accepted lot duly identified/ sealed by it, as Reference Sample to each consignee (one reference sample per consignee) for comparing the lot received at consignee end with such reference sample. Such reference samples will be treated as part of supplied quantity from the lot and cost shall be borne by the Buyer. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any)
